5641.title: Foreground shell work enters the background-task lifecycle
5641.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude task translator materializes every local_bash task without checking foreground/background execution state.
5641.proposedFix: Honor SDK background metadata, retain foreground tasks silently, and materialize background items only after a background transition. A local 218-line candidate passes the task suite but was not shipped because the provider suite has five baseline failures.
5641.caveats: Live command-to-SDK task emission, rendered UI, and steer latency were not tested. Two clean trusted-main runs reproduce the translator misclassification; no PR was opened.
